policies.summary: The Commission for Regulation of Utilities published the Large Energy Users Connection Policy decision paper (CRU/2025236) on 12 December 2025. It states that a data centre application cannot be progressed if it is in a constrained area. EirGrid notes that judicial review proceedings have been initiated against the CRU decision. A transmission operator's process implementing a regulator's decision is filed here as a regulation by curator judgment, not as a statute.
policies.source_title: EirGrid — Data Centre Connection Offer Process and Policy, Version 3 (20 May 2026)

policies.title: Common EU rating scheme and label for data centres (data centre energy efficiency package)
key_terms: aims at further improving transparency, notably through a common EU rating scheme and label for data centres
legislative proposal planned for the second quarter of 2027
launched a 12-week open public consultation and call for evidence on minimum performance standards for data centres in the EU
policies.summary: A Commission package of 21 September 2026 aims to improve transparency through a common EU rating scheme and label for data centres. On the same day the Commission opened a 12-week public consultation on minimum performance standards, with a legislative proposal planned for the second quarter of 2027. The scheme is a proposal and is not yet in force; its legal form and scrutiny stage were not confirmed on the cited page.
policies.source_title: European Commission (DG Energy) — Minimum performance standards for data centres in Europe: public consultation launched (21 Sep 2026)

resources.title: European Commission — Energy performance of data centres

policies.title: Public-Private Advisory Council on Watt-Bit Collaboration
key_terms: Public-Private Advisory Council on Watt-Bit Collaboration
the further development of data centers is becoming a very important policy issue for Japan
policies.summary: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) and Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC) announced on 18 March 2025 a public-private council on watt-bit collaboration, joining electricity and telecommunications infrastructure planning for data centres. It is a coordination forum, not a binding rule; the cited release states no obligations on data centres.
policies.source_title: METI — Public-Private Advisory Council on Watt-Bit Collaboration to Launch

policies.title: Gangwon State–KEPCO memorandum of understanding on the Gangwon AI Data Center and national backbone grid
key_terms: signed a memorandum of understanding on the successful development of the Gangwon AI Data Center
building a national backbone power grid
policies.summary: Gangwon State and the Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) signed a memorandum of understanding on cooperation to attract the planned Gangwon AI Data Center and to build a national backbone power grid. It is an agreement between a provincial government and the national utility, not a regulatory instrument, and the cited report states no binding terms.
policies.source_title: Financial News (English) — Gangwon State, KEPCO to Expand Power Infrastructure for AI Data Center

policies.title: Draft bill: rules for connecting data centres to the Greek power grid
key_terms: Power must be 60% renewable
letters of guarantee for EUR 200,000 per MW, with a three-year duration
policies.summary: Balkan Green Energy News (12 October 2026) reports a draft bill from the Ministry of Environment and Energy on connecting data centres to the grid. Power must be 60% renewable, and investors would submit letters of guarantee for EUR 200,000 per MW with a three-year duration. The record rests on the trade-press report only; the ministry or Parliament text was not reachable.
policies.source_title: Balkan Green Energy News — Greece proposes rules for connecting data centers to power grid

policies.title: AEMC advice to ministers on data-centre grid obligations (bring own firmed clean energy, flexibility, efficient connection)
key_terms: bring their own clean, firmed energy, operate flexibly and connect efficiently
policies.summary: The Australian Energy Market Commission (AEMC) recommended a package of reforms under which data centres in the grid should bring their own clean, firmed energy, operate flexibly and connect efficiently. The release title adds that data centres should pay their way. It is advice to ministers, not a rule in force.
policies.source_title: AEMC — Data centres to bring clean, firm energy, be flexible and pay their way, AEMC advises Ministers

policies.title: Green Data Centre Roadmap (IMDA, 2024)
key_terms: at least 300 megawatts of additional capacity for data centres and further additional capacity if green energy is used
Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) of less than or equal to 1.3 at 100% IT load
policies.summary: The Infocomm Media Development Authority launched Singapore's Green Data Centre Roadmap on 30 May 2024. Singapore aims to provide at least 300 megawatts of additional data-centre capacity, and further capacity if green energy is used. The IMDA has set a target for data centres to reach a PUE of 1.3 or lower at 100% IT load over the next 10 years. The text is taken from a law-firm summary because the IMDA pages were script-rendered and the factsheet was unreachable.
policies.source_title: Mayer Brown — Singapore's Green Data Centre Roadmap (Aug 2024)

policies.title: Alberta Data Centre Regulation (June 2026)
key_terms: The Data Centre Regulation (June 2026) directs the AESO to prioritize projects tethered to dedicated new generation or storage.
policies.summary: The Government of Alberta states that its Data Centre Regulation (June 2026) directs the Alberta Electric System Operator to prioritize projects tethered to dedicated new generation or storage. The regulation's own text and citation number were not consulted; this record rests on the government's explainer page.
policies.source_title: Government of Alberta — Is Alberta's grid ready?

policies.title: AESO stage-one interim large-load allocation (1,200 MW)
key_terms: set an interim limit of 1,200 megawatts
now fully allocated
policies.summary: The Alberta Electric System Operator set a one-time interim limit of 1,200 megawatts for new large data-centre load as the first stage of Alberta's large-load connection rules. The Government of Alberta's page says the amount is now fully allocated and that companies have asked to connect roughly 19,565 MW of new load. This is the government's own messaging page; the AESO publication was not cross-checked.
policies.source_title: Government of Alberta — Is Alberta's grid ready?

policies.title: North East AI Growth Zone (Blyth and Cobalt Park)
key_terms: made up of sites at Blyth in Northumberland and Cobalt in North Tyneside
policies.summary: The North East AI Growth Zone is made up of sites at Blyth (Northumberland) and Cobalt (North Tyneside). Newcastle City Council states the zone is set to unlock more than 5,000 new jobs and bring in GBP 30 billion of investment; these are the council's figures as announced, not committed community-benefit terms.
policies.source_title: Newcastle City Council — North East AI Growth Zone announced (17 September 2025)

policies.title: Geumcheon-gu data-centre resident-participation review system (head's first decision)
key_terms: 데이터센터 건축허가 신청 때 반경 200m 이내 주민 과반수의 동의서를 사업자가 의무적으로 제출하도록 하는 내용을 담았다
'데이터센터 주민참여형 검토체계 구축 및 제도 개선'을 취임 1호 결재안으로 삼았다
policies.summary: The new Geumcheon-gu head made the data-centre resident-participation review system his first approved decision. Under it, a developer must submit written consent from a majority of residents within 200 m before a data-centre building permit application. It is an administrative decision, not an ordinance.
policies.source_title: Hankyung — 내집 앞에 데이터센터 안돼…전국서 잇단 건립 반대 시위 (28 Sep 2026)

items: The content requires the developer to submit written consent from a majority of residents within a 200 m radius when applying for a data-centre building permit
made the "data-centre resident-participation review system building and institutional improvement" his first approved decision as head

policies.title: Maharashtra Integrated Green Data Centre Parks policy, amended
key_terms: increased the number of eligible projects from just three to 20
policies.summary: The amended Maharashtra policy increases the number of eligible integrated green data-centre parks from three to 20, as reported by Whalesbook.
policies.source_title: Whalesbook — Maharashtra Expands Green Data Centre Policy: Investor Impact

policies.title: Kemps Creek data centre, Penrith (SSD-10101987): state significant development approval
key_terms: Construction and Operation of a Data Centre including two data storage buildings, 61 generators, substation, high voltage switch yard, 30 diesel storage tanks
policies.summary: The NSW Planning Portal lists the Kemps Creek data centre state significant development (SSD-10101987) as approved, with a determination date of 13 July 2023. The approved scope is construction and operation of a data centre with two data storage buildings, 61 generators, a substation, a high-voltage switchyard and 30 diesel storage tanks. This is a planning approval, not a community benefit agreement.
policies.source_title: NSW Planning Portal — Kemps Creek Data Centre (SSD-10101987)

resources.title: Penrith City Council — Microsoft plans to call Penrith home

policies.title: Alberta data centre levy (Bill 12, Financial Statutes Amendment Act (No. 2), 2025)
key_terms: Introduce a levy of up to two per cent on the value of computer equipment for large data centres (with 75 megawatts of power or more).
policies.summary: The government fact sheet describes a levy of up to 2% on the value of computer equipment for data centres of 75 MW or more, with a lower rate for sites that bring their own power generation. The levy is deductible from Alberta corporate income tax. Law-firm summaries state Royal Assent in December 2025 and an effective date of 31 December 2026, but those dates were not confirmed on an official page, so the status is kept at proposed.
policies.source_title: Government of Alberta — Bill 12 Financial Statutes Amendment Act fact sheet (Data Centre Levy)

policies.title: Proposition de loi visant à encadrer l’implantation des centres de données sur le territoire français (Senate first reading)
key_terms: la publication du décret qualifiant un projet de centre de données de projet d’intérêt national majeur est subordonnée à l’organisation préalable
policies.summary: The Senate adopted at first reading a bill under which a data centre can be qualified as a major national-interest project only after the developer convenes, at its own cost, a project committee with the State, the host commune, neighbouring communes and intercommunal bodies. It also lets the administration refuse a construction permit where water resources are structurally stressed. Passed by the Senate only; not yet law.
policies.source_title: Sénat, texte adopté n° 73 (25 March 2026), proposition de loi visant à encadrer l’implantation des centres de données

items: The publication of the decree qualifying a data-centre project as a major national-interest project is conditional on a prior project committee, organised by the developer at its own cost, with the State representative, the host commune, neighbouring communes and intercommunal bodies.

policies.title: 「新栃木変電所」南側エリア データセンター整備事業 募集要項
key_terms: 「新栃木変電所」に隣接し，比較的早期に大規模な電力の供給が可能
policies.summary: Utsunomiya City's solicitation (dated 30 April 2026) selects a private data-centre developer for city-marketed land beside the Shin-Tochigi substation, which the city describes as able to supply large amounts of power relatively early. The solicitation's stated purpose is to guide data-centre siting, and the land is in an urbanisation-control zone with farmland zoning.
policies.source_title: 宇都宮市 (Utsunomiya City): 「新栃木変電所」南側エリア データセンター整備事業 募集要項, 令和8年4月30日

items: Adjacent to the 'Shin-Tochigi Substation', which can supply large amounts of power relatively early.

moratoriums.duration_description: Temporary pause announced in 2019; new capacity reopened through the pilot Data Centre Call for Application launched 20 July 2022
moratoriums.summary: The government informed industry of a temporary pause in data-centre growth in 2019 and began a review. EDB and IMDA launched a pilot Data Centre Call for Application on 20 July 2022 for new capacity with sustainability conditions; this record treats that launch as the end of the pause, but the release does not use the word lifted and states no day for the 2019 pause.
moratoriums.source_title: EDB and IMDA joint release — Launch of pilot Data Centre Call for Application (20 July 2022)

projects.name: Google Grange Castle data centre (Clondalkin)
projects.notes: Newstalk reports Google wants to build a 72,000 square metre facility at Grange Castle Business Park near Clondalkin, and that South Dublin County Council refused planning permission in August 2024. announced_year is the year of that refusal, the earliest dated source captured. An appeal was reported by secondary sources only and is not recorded.
projects.source_title: Newstalk — Google refused permission to build huge Dublin data centre

projects.name: Nscale Loughton data centre
projects.notes: Data Centre Review reports the Essex scheme received outline approval in 2024 (announced_year is that year) and that the revised scheme is 50% higher than originally proposed and includes 50% more internal capacity. The final decision lies with Epping Forest District Council. An Nscale spokesperson told The Telegraph it expects construction to begin in Q2 2026 and the site to be operational in Q2 2027.
projects.source_title: Data Centre Review — Nscale latest to face public backlash over proposed data centre

projects.name: Segro Le Bourget data centre (former H&M warehouse)
projects.notes: A 75 MW data centre planned by property firm Segro at a former H&M warehouse. The newly elected mayor is demanding its cancellation. Segro says it will recover heat from 12 MW of the 75 MW used. announced_year is the year of the source article (30 June 2026), the earliest dated source captured.
projects.source_title: BeBeez — Mayor could block data center planned at former H&M warehouse in Le Bourget, France

projects.name: Google Beauharnois data centre
projects.notes: Hydro-Québec's May 2021 release describes a potential investment of US$600 million (approximately C$735 million) and close to 30 specialized jobs, on 62.4 hectares of Hydro-Québec land. No later status was found.
projects.source_title: Hydro-Québec newsroom — Project to expand Google's activities in Québec: future data center in Beauharnois

projects.name: Cerrillos Data Center
projects.notes: BioBioChile reported on 17 September 2024 that Google decided not to continue its permit request for a data centre in Cerrillos and would redesign the project with air cooling at an investment of 200 million dollars; the figure refers to the redesigned plan. The mayor rejected the new plan, saying it lacked the necessary legal studies. Status rests on that article alone. announced_year is the year of the earliest dated source captured. Coordinates are the Cerrillos commune centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.
projects.source_title: BioBioChile — Alcaldesa de Cerrillos rechaza nuevo plan de data center de Google

projects.name: Google Quilicura data center
projects.notes: Google's blog describes the site as its first data centre in Latin America. es.wikipedia records that Google announced construction there on 6 September 2012, so announced_year is 2012. Coordinates are the Quilicura commune centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.
projects.source_title: Google (Blog, Latinoamérica) — 10 datos sobre el centro de datos de Google en Quilicura, Chile

projects.name: Microsoft Chile Central cloud region
projects.notes: Microsoft's release says its first cloud region in Chile, in the Santiago Metropolitan Region, is operational. About 3.3 billion dollars is to be invested directly in Chile, and Microsoft cites an estimated 81,041 jobs in 2025 to 2029; the jobs figure is a national estimate, not a count for this site. announced_year is the year of the opening release. Coordinates are the Santiago city centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.
projects.source_title: Microsoft News Center Latinoamérica — Microsoft inaugura su primera Región de Datacenters en Chile

projects.name: AWS data centre, Bahía Blanca free-trade zone (Tango Sur / Centro / Norte)
projects.notes: Reuters, published 25 October 2019, reports AWS received authorization to build a data centre in a free-trade zone in Buenos Aires province with an estimated investment of US$800 million. No completion or withdrawal source was read. Coordinates are the Bahía Blanca city centroid from es.wikipedia, approximate.
projects.source_title: Diario Financiero (Reuters) — Argentina aprueba construcción de centro de datos de Amazon

projects.name: Project Mars, Lane Cove
projects.notes: ACS Information Age reports Goodman's head of planning advised the NSW government that the company had formally withdrawn its development application for a proposed 90 MW data centre in Lane Cove. Planning began in March 2025 per a letter quoted by ACS. The NSW Planning Portal was not read.
projects.source_title: ACS Information Age — Controversial Sydney data centre plan scrapped

projects.name: Microsoft Sandviken datacentre (three planned facilities)
projects.notes: Microsoft's blog says the three planned facilities will create an estimated 300 permanent skilled technician jobs in Sandviken. The blog is undated; announced_year 2021 is the Sweden region announcement year from a search summary that was not probed. Construction status was not verified.
projects.source_title: Microsoft Local — Growing together: How Microsoft's datacenters are empowering communities in Sandviken and Gävle

projects.name: Microsoft Finland datacentre region (Espoo and Kirkkonummi), waste heat to Fortum district heating
projects.notes: Microsoft's 17 March 2022 release says that, in collaboration with Fortum, waste heat from the datacenters will be converted to district heating serving Espoo, Kauniainen and Kirkkonummi. Update 2026-10-19: Microsoft's 28 April 2026 announcement (https://news.microsoft.com/source/emea/2026/04/microsoft-kaynnistaa-paakaupunkiseudun-datakeskusalueen-toisen-vaiheen-rakentamisen/?lang=fi) confirms the second-phase build decision for the Espoo, Kirkkonummi and Vihti data-centre area, states that first-phase construction began in late 2024, and states that building permits exist for the second phase at all three campuses. Power and investment are still not stated in the text read.
projects.source_title: Microsoft News Europe — Microsoft announces intent to build a new datacenter region in Finland

projects.name: Google Hamina data centre campus (expansion and heat-recovery project)
projects.notes: Business Finland reports Google's 20 May 2024 announcement of a new €1 billion investment in expanding its Hamina campus (announced_year is the expansion year; the page also dates the campus to 2009), with heat recovery for the district-heating network. The expansion's construction status was not verified. Update 2026-10-19: a CapMan Infra release reprinted by IREI (article dated 18 May 2026) reports that the Haminan Energia heat-recovery facility was delivered within a year with first heat supplied in the fourth quarter of 2025, and that once fully operational it is expected to cover around 70-75 percent of Hamina's district heating energy. The 2024 announcement had put the figure at about 80%; both are stored as their sources state.
projects.source_title: Business Finland — Google announced an expansion of its Hamina data center and a new heat recovery project

projects.name: Microsoft Attica data centres (Spata Site 6; Kropia Sites 27 and 28)
projects.notes: The ministry portal lists three data-centre sites: Site 6 (19.2 MW) in Spata-Artemida and Sites 27 and 28 (9.6 MW each) in Kropia, with a budget of 976.168.800 €. The portal states no total, so power_mw is not set. Enterprise Greece describes the investment as 'several hundred million', a different scale; both are stored as their sources state. Update 2026-10-19: To Vima (2 January 2026) reports that the Spata site is part of a broader Microsoft complex of approximately 85 stremmas in Eastern Attica, with a total capacity of 25 MW and a completion target of 2028. These are press figures, not Microsoft-published, and sit alongside the ministry portal's per-site figures above.
projects.source_title: Greek Ministry of Development — Investment in Data Centres in Greece (ependyseis portal)

projects.name: Google Waltham Cross data centre (Hertfordshire)
projects.notes: Google's 16 September 2025 post announces the opening of the Waltham Cross data centre as part of a two-year £5 billion UK investment; that figure is company-wide, so no site investment is stored. announced_year is 2024, the year given in the earlier wave-1 lead; the cited post itself dates the opening. A Broxbourne Council item describes the site as Cheshunt (Theobalds Business Park). Coordinates were not probed.
projects.source_title: Google — Our new Waltham Cross data center is part of our two-year, £5 billion investment to help power the UK's AI economy (16 Sep 2025)

projects.name: Stargate Argentina (OpenAI and Sur Energy), letter of intent, site not named
projects.notes: Sur Energy's release says the two companies signed a Letter of Intent for a data-centre project reaching up to 500MW, with up to $25 billion in investment at full scale. No official page names the province or site, so subdivision and coordinates are empty. Sur Energy is the developer; it is not a tracked company, so the record sits under OpenAI, the other signatory. A separate Neuquén project (Pampa Energía, 500 MW) is a different project and is not attached. OpenAI's own page returned 403 to the probe.
projects.source_title: Sur Energy — Sur Energy and OpenAI plan Stargate Argentina (press release, 10 Oct 2025)

projects.name: Google AI hub, Visakhapatnam (1 GW)
projects.notes: Investment is the site figure: The News Minute (14 October 2025) reports a data centre in Visakhapatnam “with an investment of Rs 87,520 crore (USD 10 billion)”. The $15 billion in Google's announcement is its five-year plan for the India AI hub and is not stored as the site figure; Google's blog says Google's AI hub is powered by that $15 billion investment. Coordinates are the Visakhapatnam city centroid, not the site.
projects.source_title: The South First — Google's largest AI hub outside US coming up in Visakhapatnam

updates.title: Andhra Pradesh orders transfer of 480 acres to Adani Infra for the Google AI data centre
updates.summary: A government order issued on 2 December 2025, following a Council of Ministers meeting on 28 November 2025, permits the transfer of 480 acres in Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli districts to Adani Infra (India) Pvt Ltd, a notified partner of Google's Raiden Infotech India.
updates.source_title: Deccan Chronicle (PTI) — Andhra Govt Allots 480 Acres for Adani-Google AI Data Centre in Visakhapatnam

updates.title: Andhra Pradesh High Court issues notice on public-interest petition against the data centre
updates.summary: The petition, filed by environmental activist Bolisetty Satyanarayana, questions the project's Environmental Clearance and the allotment of 160 acres of temple land. The court issued notice on 1 July 2026.
updates.source_title: LiveLaw — AP High Court issues notice on PIL challenging Google-Adani data centre project

updates.title: State tells High Court it is taking steps to protect the environment at the data centre site
updates.summary: On 24 August 2026 the Andhra Pradesh government told the High Court it is taking every step to ensure construction of the Google-Adani data centres does not affect the environment. The petition seeks a halt to construction until comprehensive environmental impact studies are carried out.
updates.source_title: Bar & Bench — Google-Adani data centre will not affect environment: Andhra Pradesh government tells High Court

updates.title: Reported: National Green Tribunal seeks Centre's response to appeal against environmental clearance
updates.summary: Bar & Bench reported on 16 October 2026 that the National Green Tribunal has sought the Central government's response to a plea challenging the environmental clearance for the Google-Adani Visakhapatnam data centre project. The page does not state the date of the Tribunal's order.
updates.source_title: Bar & Bench — NGT seeks Centre's response to plea against clearance for Google-Adani's Rs 17,700 crore Vizag data centre

projects.name: Amazon data centre, Balkum, Thane
projects.notes: Proposed hyperscale data centre in Balkum, Thane, attributed to Amazon by the newspaper headline; no Amazon-issued record was probed. announced_year is the year of the earliest dated source captured (18 July 2026 protest report), not a confirmed announcement year. No capacity or investment is stated in the source. Coordinates are the Thane city centroid, not the site.
projects.source_title: Free Press Journal — Wake Up Thanekar representative opposes proposed Amazon data centre project

projects.name: AWS AI Zone, Ulsan (SK Group build-out)
projects.notes: The release says SK Group will lead construction of the Ulsan data center while AWS establishes the AI Zone, scheduled to begin operations by 2027, and that it is expected to generate up to 78,000 direct and indirect jobs over time. claimed_jobs is that combined figure. No site-level investment is stated; AWS's US $5.88 billion Korea plan is country-wide. Coordinates are the Ulsan city centroid, not the site.
projects.source_title: SK Telecom press release — SK Group and AWS team up to build cloud computing infrastructure (22 Jun 2025)

projects.name: Stargate Korea (OpenAI with Samsung SDS and SK Telecom)
projects.notes: Announced in October 2025 as two data centres, one led by Samsung SDS and one by SK Telecom, under an OpenAI partnership. The cited report says little progress has been made on construction and the funding structure, and that no progress has been made following October's memorandum of understanding. Samsung SDS and SK Telecom are not tracked companies, so the record sits under OpenAI. No site was named in any probed source, so coordinates are empty and the record is not map-ready.
projects.source_title: Korea JoongAng Daily — OpenAI's Stargate project in Korea stuck at starting gate

projects.name: Microsoft Québec data centres (Québec-Lévis economic zone)
projects.notes: BetaKit (22 November 2023) reports Microsoft earmarking $685 million CAD ($500 million USD) over two years to expand cloud and AI infrastructure in Québec. Other reports name four Québec City-region municipalities, but only the Lévis location was matched on the cited page. The line about locating in the Québec-Lévis economic zone is a Québec minister's, not Microsoft's. Construction status was not verified. Coordinates are the Lévis municipal centre, not a site address.
projects.source_title: BetaKit — Microsoft looks to scale Québec presence with $500-million USD investment

projects.name: Brookfield AI data centre, Strängnäs
projects.notes: SVT (8 June 2025) reports a planned investment of 95 billion kronor by Brookfield Asset Management and a 750 MW load. No 2026 zoning decision or grid agreement was found. Coordinates are the Strängnäs town centre, not the site.
projects.source_title: SVT Nyheter Sörmland — Lokala kraftnätet klarar inte enorma AI-satsningen i Strängnäs (8 Jun 2025)

projects.name: Google Muhos data centre
projects.notes: Google's own site page (dated September 2026) says work is proceeding in full compliance with obtained permits; the page describes site activity as preliminary infrastructure development. announced_year is the year of the earliest dated source captured (the September 2026 page); the original announcement year was not verified. No capacity or investment figure was found. Coordinates are the Muhos town centre, not the site.
projects.source_title: Google Data Centers — Muhos, Finland

projects.name: AWS Huechuraba storage data centre (Centro de Almacenamiento Huechuraba)
projects.notes: Forbes Chile (6 April 2026) reports a US$205 million investment; the figure is press-reported, not from an AWS release. The environmental approval was reported by press as 12 July 2024 (announced_year); the SEA record was not fetched. Phase 1 construction was reported to begin in December 2025 but no 2026 confirmation was found, so the status stays announced. Coordinates were not probed.
projects.source_title: Forbes Chile — Justicia ambiental da luz verde al proyecto de data center de Amazon en Huechuraba (6 Apr 2026)

projects.name: Hokkaido Tomakomai AI Data Center
projects.notes: SoftBank held the groundbreaking ceremony on 15 April 2025; operations are scheduled to begin in fiscal 2026. SoftBank says the 700,000 m² campus is expected to have a power capacity exceeding 300 MW (a lower bound, so power_mw is left empty). Coordinates are Tomakomai's town centre, not the site.
projects.source_title: SoftBank News — Construction Begins on Hokkaido Tomakomai AI Data Center

projects.name: NEXTDC S7 (OpenAI AI campus)
projects.notes: NEXTDC's ASX announcement says OpenAI and NEXTDC will collaborate on the planning, development and operation of a hyperscale AI campus and large-scale GPU supercluster at the S7 site in Eastern Creek, Sydney, under a memorandum of understanding. Capacity in planning documents was not confirmed, so power_mw is empty.
projects.source_title: NEXTDC — NEXTDC to Join OpenAI in Australia as an Infrastructure Partner (ASX announcement, 5 Dec 2025)

projects.name: XTX Markets Kajaani data centre complex
projects.notes: XTX Markets announced plans on 22 January 2025 to invest over €1bn in a data-centre complex in Kajaani; the first data centre has three data halls totalling 22.5 MW of IT power (IT load, not grid capacity, so power_mw is empty). Coordinates are Kajaani's town centre.
projects.source_title: XTX Markets — XTX Markets plans to invest over €1bn in large-scale data centre project in Finland (22 Jan 2025)

projects.name: QTS Cambois data centre campus
projects.notes: QTS page: outline planning permission approved; QTS has begun submitting detailed approvals to Northumberland County Council and says it will update as it moves towards starting works on site. announced_year is the earliest dated item on the page (2025). projects.source_title: QTS — Cambois data centre campus

The NSW Planning Portal records the state significant development (SSD-10101987) as approved on 13/07/2023; no construction start was matched, so status stays announced. No coordinates were probed.
projects.source_title: Penrith City Council — Microsoft plans to call Penrith home

projects.name: Ozans-Châteauroux data centre and grid connection (Etrechet, Indre)

rate_cases.title: Hydro-Québec's proposed data-centre rate (tarif CD)
rate_cases.next_milestone: Hearings scheduled 7–11 December and 15–18 December 2026 (after sessions held 1–9 October), per the docket.
rate_cases.summary: Hydro-Québec Distribution asked the Régie de l'énergie to set a new rate for data centres (tarif CD), together with an adjustment to the rate for cryptographic blockchain use. Hydro-Québec says the rate is equivalent to an average of 13¢/kWh, approximately double what current large-power customers pay, and is subject to the Régie's approval. The Régie lists the docket as ongoing ("En cours"). Hydro-Québec's release states the rate applies to data centres requiring a capacity greater than 5 MW and is expected to take effect in the second half of 2026, subject to approval by the Régie.
rate_cases.source_title: Régie de l'énergie — Dossier R-4333-2026 (HQD, tarifs centres de données)
